purpose: Freeze and independently restore the complete live source, contract, evidence and governance dependency closure for the contract-green S6-I1 through S6-I4 implementation before any S6-E0 optimizer execution is considered.

live_dependency_closure.selection_rule: Every tracked file at the accepted authorization-record commit except paths under governance/frozen/. The excluded paths are immutable historical snapshots and archives, are not imported or opened by the 46 frozen tests, and are bound separately below to avoid recursive snapshot nesting.
live_dependency_closure.index_canonicalization: For git ls-tree -r -l rows in path order outside governance/frozen/: path + NUL + mode + NUL + blob_oid + NUL + size + LF, UTF-8, SHA-256.

runtime_dependency_scan.test_path_resolution: All tests resolve src/ and the five fixture files relative to the restored project root.

live_dependency_closure.acceptance_snapshot_rule: After author acceptance, add only the authorization record and project-ledger provenance, commit locally, recompute the selected-file manifest at that authorization-record commit, and stop if any bound source, frozen contract or evidence hash changed.

separately_bound_historical_snapshots.boundary: Exclusion prevents recursive duplication only. It does not revoke, replace or weaken any earlier freeze or amendment rule.

P.meaning: Create a new immutable snapshot directory, per-file manifest and ZIP for the live non-recursive dependency closure after recording this authorization.

R.meaning: Restore the new ZIP into an independently created empty directory, verify exact files and hashes, and run only the 46 frozen deterministic contract tests plus AST/import checks.

E.meaning: Do not construct or execute the S6-E0 optimizer, problem adapters, benchmarks, simulations, pilot, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or TCAC.

F.meaning: The restore verification uses only deterministic pre-evaluated fixtures and must perform no objective or constraint evaluation.

freeze_and_restore_procedure_if_authoriz: Recompute this candidate SHA-256, all four production-source hashes, all five implementation-evidence hashes, the 11-file frozen red baseline and the three historical archive hashes.
Create a hash-bound authorization record carrying the author's exact P/R/E/F decision and commit it locally with no remote.
Enumerate every tracked file at the authorization-record commit except governance/frozen/**, write a per-file SHA-256/byte manifest, and create a new immutable snapshot directory and ZIP.
Restore the ZIP into a newly created empty directory; reject any missing, extra or hash-mismatched file.
Run only python -B -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q for the 46 frozen deterministic tests, then AST/source-path-scoped import checks; do not install dependencies or call an evaluator.
Record acceptance, manifest/archive hashes, direct exits, environment identity and zero-execution accounting; stop before S6-E0.
hard_stop_conditions: The candidate hash, a production-source hash, a frozen contract hash, a bound evidence hash or a historical archive hash differs.
The working tree contains an unexplained source, test, fixture, evidence or governance change at acceptance time.
The live-closure selection would omit a path imported or opened by the frozen tests.
The restore target is not newly created and empty, or restored files differ from the manifest.
Any of the 46 frozen tests, AST checks or imports fails for a package-content reason.
Any dependency installation, network access, remote Git action, optimizer/evaluator call, benchmark/simulation, formal run package or formal FFE would be required.
explicitly_not_authorized: freezing or restoring this candidate without the author's hash-bound acceptance
editing frozen specifications, fixtures or tests
changing the four production modules or their behavior
creating an optimizer loop, evaluator, problem adapter or executable experiment run package
optimizer, benchmark, simulation, pilot, M, C1, F, C2, Stage B or TCAC execution
objective or constraint evaluation or formal FFE
dependency installation, network, remote Git, public release, preregistration-platform action, preprint or submission
performance, superiority, convergence, robustness, objective-novelty, physical-validation or paper-readiness conclusions

freeze_effect_if_authorized.meaning: The complete restored source/evidence package reproduces 46 frozen unit-contract passes with zero formal FFE in the recorded environment.
freeze_effect_if_authorized.does_not_mean: A complete executable optimizer or experiment system exists, any benchmark result exists, or the algorithm can yet support a paper.
freeze_effect_if_authorized.next_gate: Prepare a separate hash-bound S6-E0 implementation and optimizer-execution authorization only after successful restore verification.
